sentences.english: I love to sing in the shower.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢在洗澡时唱歌。

sentences.english: She sings so beautifully that everyone stops what they're doing just to listen.
sentences.chinese: 她唱得太美了，大家都停下手中的事来听。

sentences.english: Whenever I feel down, I put on my headphones and sing along to my favorite songs, and by the time I'm done, I always feel a hundred times better.
sentences.chinese: 每当我情绪低落，我就戴上耳机跟着我最喜欢的歌一起唱，唱完之后总感觉好了一百倍。

sentences.english: This song is so catchy.
sentences.chinese: 这首歌太上头了。

sentences.english: I heard a song on the radio that reminded me of our road trip last summer.
sentences.chinese: 我在电台听到一首歌，让我想起了去年夏天的公路旅行。

sentences.english: That old song brings back so many memories of high school, when we used to drive around with the windows down and sing at the top of our lungs.
sentences.chinese: 那首老歌勾起了太多高中时的回忆，那时我们经常摇下车窗，扯着嗓子大声唱歌。

sentences.english: We like to sing English songs in class.
sentences.chinese: 我们喜欢在课堂上唱英文歌。

sentences.english: Singing English songs really helps me improve my pronunciation and vocabulary.
sentences.chinese: 唱英文歌真的帮我校正了发音，还增加了词汇量。

sentences.english: When I first started learning English, I couldn't understand the lyrics at all, but now I can sing English songs and actually know the meaning behind every word.
sentences.chinese: 刚开始学英语时，我完全听不懂歌词，但现在我能唱英文歌，而且还能听懂每个词背后的意思。

sentences.english: She can play the pipa beautifully.
sentences.chinese: 她琵琶弹得很动听。

sentences.english: I'm taking lessons to learn how to play the pipa at a traditional music school.
sentences.chinese: 我在一家传统音乐学校上课，学习弹琵琶。

sentences.english: My grandmother taught me how to play the pipa when I was a little girl, and it's a skill that connects me deeply to my family's history.
sentences.chinese: 小时候奶奶教我弹琵琶，这项技艺将我和家族历史紧紧联系在一起。

sentences.english: I love watching kung fu movies.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢看功夫片。

sentences.english: He has been practicing kung fu for over ten years and is a black belt now.
sentences.chinese: 他练功夫已经十多年了，现在是黑带。

sentences.english: Kung fu is not just about fighting; it's about finding inner peace, respecting your opponent, and training both your body and your spirit.
sentences.chinese: 功夫不仅是打斗，它关乎寻找内心平静，尊重对手，以及锻炼身心。

sentences.english: Let's go do kung fu after school.
sentences.chinese: 放学后我们去练功夫吧。

sentences.english: I do kung fu twice a week to stay active and relieve stress.
sentences.chinese: 我每周练两次功夫来保持活力、缓解压力。

sentences.english: When I was a kid, my dad enrolled me in a class to do kung fu because I was getting picked on, and it turned out to be the best thing that ever happened to my confidence.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候因为被欺负，爸爸送我去练功夫，结果那成了建立我自信心最棒的一件事。
sentences.scene: 功夫带来的成长与改变

sentences.english: Let's dance to this song!
sentences.chinese: 我们跟着这首歌跳起来吧！
sentences.scene: 派对上听到喜欢的音乐

sentences.english: She loves to dance, so we're taking salsa lessons together every Friday.
sentences.chinese: 她酷爱跳舞，所以我们每周五一起去上萨尔萨舞课。

sentences.english: I have two left feet, but I still dance at weddings because it's about having fun, not about looking perfect.
sentences.chinese: 我笨手笨脚的，但在婚礼上我依然会跳舞，因为跳舞是为了开心，不是要看着完美。
sentences.scene: 在婚礼上放下包袱尽情舞动

sentences.english: I like to draw animals.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢画动物。
sentences.scene: 拿出画笔时的爱好分享

sentences.english: Can you draw a quick sketch of my dog? You're so talented.
sentences.chinese: 你能帮我的狗画张速写吗？你画得太好了。
sentences.scene: 请求朋友发挥绘画才能

sentences.english: As a kid, I used to draw on my bedroom walls, and instead of getting angry, my mom bought me a giant sketchbook and saved the wall.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候喜欢在卧室墙上画画，妈妈非但没生气，还给我买了个巨大的素描本，救了那面墙。
sentences.scene: 父母鼓励创造力的温馨举动

sentences.english: I still watch cartoons on Saturday mornings.
sentences.chinese: 我周六早上还是会看动画片。

sentences.english: That cartoon is hilarious; even the parents are laughing out loud.
sentences.chinese: 这部动画片太搞笑了，连家长们都在哈哈大笑。

sentences.english: My favorite cartoon growing up was about a clever rabbit, and I never missed a single episode after school.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候最爱的动画片是关于一只聪明兔子的，我放学后一集都没落下过。

sentences.english: He can draw cartoons really fast.
sentences.chinese: 他画漫画画得特别快。

sentences.english: I'm learning to draw cartoons by watching online tutorials after dinner.
sentences.chinese: 我晚饭后正跟着网上的教程学画漫画。

sentences.english: Whenever I'm bored during a long meeting, I secretly draw cartoons of my boss in my notebook to stay awake.
sentences.chinese: 每次在冗长的会议上感到无聊，我就偷偷在笔记本上画老板的漫画来提神。
sentences.scene: 枯燥会议中的自娱自乐

sentences.english: I can cook spaghetti.
sentences.chinese: 我会做意大利面。
sentences.scene: 回答是否具备做饭技能

sentences.english: My dad loves to cook a huge breakfast for the whole family on Sundays.
sentences.chinese: 我爸爸喜欢在周日给全家做一顿丰盛的早餐。
sentences.scene: 家庭美食日的温馨画面

sentences.english: I never learned to cook until I moved into my own apartment, and after a week of terrible instant noodles, I finally called my mom for her recipes.
sentences.chinese: 我搬进自己的公寓后一直没学做饭，吃了一周难吃的泡面后，终于打电话向妈妈要来了她的食谱。
sentences.scene: 独立生活后开始学做饭

sentences.english: Let's go swim in the lake.
sentences.chinese: 我们去湖里游泳吧。

sentences.english: I usually swim laps at the community pool before heading to the office.
sentences.chinese: 我通常上班前去社区泳池游几个来回。

sentences.english: Learning to swim as an adult was terrifying at first, but now it's the most relaxing part of my week and I can't imagine life without it.
sentences.chinese: 成年后才学游泳起初很可怕，但现在这已是我一周中最放松的时刻，无法想象没有它的生活。

sentences.english: Do you want to play basketball?
sentences.chinese: 你想去打篮球吗？
sentences.scene: 在球场向朋友发出邀请

sentences.english: We play basketball every Saturday morning at the park, rain or shine.
sentences.chinese: 我们每周六早上都在公园打篮球，风雨无阻。
sentences.scene: 雷打不动的周末固定活动

sentences.english: I used to play basketball in high school, and even though I spent most of the time on the bench, I still miss the energy of the game and the team spirit.
sentences.chinese: 我高中的时候打过篮球，虽然大部分时间都坐冷板凳，但我依然怀念比赛的激情和团队精神。
sentences.scene: 对高中篮球时光的怀念

sentences.english: I bought a new ping-pong paddle.
sentences.chinese: 我买了一个新的乒乓球拍。

sentences.english: We have a ping-pong table in the office basement, and it gets very competitive.
sentences.chinese: 我们办公室地下室里有一张乒乓球桌，比赛经常非常激烈。

sentences.english: Ping-pong is a huge deal in my family; we hold tournaments every holiday, and my grandma, who is eighty, still hits the hardest smashes.
sentences.chinese: 乒乓球在我家是件大事，每次过节都有比赛，我八十岁的奶奶依然能扣出最狠的球。
sentences.scene: 家庭乒乓比赛的传奇人物

sentences.english: Let's play ping-pong after dinner.
sentences.chinese: 晚饭后我们去打乒乓球吧。

sentences.english: I like to play ping-pong, but I'm terrible at serving the ball.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢打乒乓球，但我的发球糟透了。

sentences.english: During our break, a few of us play ping-pong in the garage, and it's the perfect way to clear our minds before getting back to work.
sentences.chinese: 休息时，我们几个在车库里打乒乓球，这是在回去工作前清醒头脑的绝妙方式。
sentences.scene: 利用休息时间放松一下

sentences.english: Please speak English with me.
sentences.chinese: 请跟我一起说英语。

sentences.english: My goal is to speak English fluently enough to travel alone next year.
sentences.chinese: 我的目标是明年能流利地说英语，可以独自去旅行。

sentences.english: I was always too shy to speak English because I was afraid of making mistakes, but my teacher said making mistakes is just proof that you're trying.
sentences.chinese: 我以前总因为怕犯错而不敢说英语，但我的老师说，犯错恰恰证明你在努力尝试。
sentences.scene: 克服说英语的心理障碍

sentences.english: We'll see you tomorrow.
sentences.chinese: 我们明天见。

sentences.english: Don't worry about the mess; we'll clean it up before the guests arrive.
sentences.chinese: 别担心乱糟糟的，我们会在客人来之前收拾好的。

sentences.english: If the weather is nice this weekend, we'll go hiking in the mountains, and if it rains, we'll just have a movie marathon at home.
sentences.chinese: 如果这个周末天气好，我们就去山里徒步，如果下雨，我们就在家搞个电影马拉松。
sentences.scene: 根据天气制定的双计划

sentences.english: There's a party at my house tonight.
sentences.chinese: 今晚我家有个派对。
sentences.scene: 向朋友发出邀请或告知

sentences.english: We threw a surprise party for her birthday, and she totally didn't expect it.
sentences.chinese: 我们给她办了惊喜生日派对，她完全没料到。

sentences.english: The party was so loud that the neighbors upstairs came down to complain, but after we invited them in, they ended up staying until midnight.
sentences.chinese: 派对太吵了，楼上的邻居下来投诉，但我们把他们邀请进来后，他们一直待到半夜才走。
sentences.scene: 派对气氛好到让投诉的邻居加入

sentences.english: I'll see you next week.
sentences.chinese: 下周见。

sentences.english: What's the next step after we finish writing the report?
sentences.chinese: 写完报告后，下一步做什么？

sentences.english: I can't wait for the next episode of this show; the story ended on such a huge cliffhanger that I literally screamed.
sentences.chinese: 我等不及看这部剧的下一集了，结尾停在那么大的悬念上，我真的叫出了声。
sentences.scene: 追剧被吊胃口后的急切心情

sentences.english: That's a wonderful idea!
sentences.chinese: 那是个绝妙的主意！

sentences.english: The weather is absolutely wonderful today; let's eat lunch outside.
sentences.chinese: 今天的天气实在是太好了，我们出去吃午饭吧。

sentences.english: It was a wonderful experience to volunteer at the animal shelter; seeing those rescued puppies find new homes filled my heart with joy.
sentences.chinese: 在动物收容所当志愿者是一次很棒的经历，看着那些被救的小狗找到新家，我心里充满了喜悦。
sentences.scene: 分享公益活动带来的感动

sentences.english: I want to learn how to surf.
sentences.chinese: 我想学冲浪。

sentences.english: It's never too late to learn a new language or pick up an instrument.
sentences.chinese: 学习一门新语言或学一件乐器，什么时候开始都不晚。

sentences.english: I learned how to cook by watching my grandmother in the kitchen, and those hands-on lessons were way better than any cooking show.
sentences.chinese: 我是在厨房里看奶奶做饭学会烹饪的，那些手把手的教导比任何美食节目都好得多。
sentences.scene: 怀念向长辈学习技艺的时光

sentences.english: Do you have any questions?
sentences.chinese: 你们有什么问题吗？
sentences.scene: 老师或演讲者询问听众

sentences.english: I don't have any cash on me, so can I pay with my phone?
sentences.chinese: 我身上没带现金，能手机支付吗？

sentences.english: Let me know if you need any help moving the heavy furniture; I'm free all weekend and happy to lend a hand.
sentences.chinese: 搬重家具要是需要帮忙就跟我说，我整个周末都有空，很乐意搭把手。
sentences.scene: 热心向朋友提供体力活帮助

sentences.english: What's the problem?
sentences.chinese: 出什么问题了？

sentences.english: I have a problem with my laptop; it keeps shutting down randomly.
sentences.chinese: 我笔记本电脑出了个问题，它老是随机关机。

sentences.english: The biggest problem with living in the city center is the noise at night, but the convenience of walking everywhere makes up for it.
sentences.chinese: 住市中心最大的问题就是晚上太吵，但去哪都能走路到达的便利弥补了这点。

sentences.english: No problem, I'm happy to help!
sentences.chinese: 没问题，我很乐意帮忙！
sentences.scene: 爽快地回应别人的请求

sentences.english: Thanks for driving me home in the rain. — No problem, it's on my way.
sentences.chinese: 谢谢你冒雨送我回家。— 没事儿，顺路而已。
sentences.scene: 顺路帮忙后的轻松对白

sentences.english: When I accidentally spilled coffee on her white carpet, I nearly died of embarrassment, but she just laughed and said, 'No problem, I have a great cleaner.'
sentences.chinese: 我不小心把咖啡洒在她的白地毯上，尴尬得要死，但她只是笑着说：没问题，我有个很棒的清洁剂。
sentences.scene: 窘迫时刻被宽容以待的温暖

sentences.english: I want some ice cream.
sentences.chinese: 我想吃点冰淇淋。

sentences.english: What do you want to do for your birthday this year?
sentences.chinese: 你今年生日想怎么过？

sentences.english: I want to visit every national park in the country someday, so I've started a savings fund just for that dream trip.
sentences.chinese: 我想有朝一日能游览全国的每一个国家公园，为此我已经开始给这个梦想旅行存钱了。
sentences.scene: 宏伟旅行计划的存钱目标

sentences.english: Please send me the photos.
sentences.chinese: 请把照片发给我。
sentences.scene: 聚会后向朋友索要照片

sentences.english: Can you send a quick message to the group chat about tomorrow's change of plans?
sentences.chinese: 你能在群里发条消息，说一下明天的计划有变吗？

sentences.english: I sent my job application last Monday, and I've been checking my email every ten minutes since then, hoping for a reply.
sentences.chinese: 我上周一寄出了求职申请，从那以后我就每隔十分钟查一次邮件，盼着收到回复。

sentences.english: I check my email every morning.
sentences.chinese: 我每天早上都查邮件。

sentences.english: Please send the report as an email attachment before the end of the day.
sentences.chinese: 请在今天下班前把报告以邮件附件的形式发给我。

sentences.english: I used to write long letters to my pen pal, but now we just exchange emails because it's faster.
sentences.chinese: 我以前常给笔友写长信，但现在我们只发电子邮件了，因为更快。
sentences.scene: 交流方式随时代的变迁

sentences.english: I'm at the library right now.
sentences.chinese: 我现在在图书馆。

sentences.english: Please meet me at the main entrance at exactly 5 p.m.
sentences.chinese: 下午五点整在主入口见。
sentences.scene: 约定见面的精确地点和时间

sentences.english: I was standing at the bus stop when I realized I had left my wallet at home, so I had to run back and was almost late for work.
sentences.chinese: 我站在公交车站时，突然意识到钱包落家里了，只好跑回去拿，结果上班差点迟到。
